panels.title: Orders confirmed / min
panels.description: Orders that completed the whole saga successfully.

panels.title: Orders cancelled / min
panels.description: Orders rolled back: payment declined, out of stock, timed out, or cancelled by the customer.

panels.title: Cancellation rate (5m)
panels.description: Share of finished orders that were cancelled. The alert fires above 30%.

panels.title: Oldest unpublished event
panels.description: How long the oldest event has waited in an outbox. Anything above a minute means events are stuck.

panels.title: Services up
panels.description: Scrape targets that are up (5 expected: gateway, order, inventory, payment, notification).

panels.title: Alerts firing
panels.description: Prometheus alerts currently firing. Details at http://localhost:9099/alerts.

panels.title: Gateway requests / s by route and status
panels.description: Every request the gateway served, including those rejected by authentication or rate limiting (401, 429).

panels.title: Gateway latency (p50 / p95 / p99)
panels.description: Time to answer a request. Ordering is asynchronous, so this stays low even though the saga takes longer.

panels.title: Order outcomes / min by reason
panels.description: Reason is payment_failed, out_of_stock, timeout or customer for cancellations.

panels.title: Saga duration (p50 / p95)
panels.description: Time from placing an order to its final state (confirmed or cancelled).

panels.title: gRPC calls served / s by service and result
panels.description: Calls each service handled, by gRPC status code.

panels.title: gRPC latency p95 by service
panels.description: 95th percentile time to serve a gRPC call.

panels.title: Messages consumed / s by consumer and outcome
panels.description: ack = handled, retry = will be redelivered, terminated = dropped as unprocessable.

panels.title: Outbox backlog
panels.description: Events waiting to be published. Should hover at zero.

panels.title: Payments and provider calls / s
panels.description: failed = declined by the provider. provider error = outage or timeout (retried).

panels.title: Stock reservations / s
panels.description: rejected = not enough stock. Releases are the saga's compensation.

panels.title: Notifications / s by channel and outcome

options.content: **Traces:** [Jaeger UI](http://localhost:16686) - search service pi-gateway, or the tag order.id=<order id>; every response carries an X-Trace-Id header.  |  **Alerts:** [Prometheus](http://localhost:9099/alerts)  |  **Logs:** every log line of a request carries its 	race_id  (docker compose logs <service>).
